items.video_title: Cultus Overheat Ho Rahi Hai? Ye Solution Dekh Lein (100% Kaam Karega)
items.video_description:
Suzuki Cultus overheat ya heatup ki problem se pareshan hain? Is video mein hum ne is problem ka pakka aur asaan solution dikhaya hai jo koi bhi ghar par kar sakta hai.
🔧 Is video mein cover kiya gaya hai:
Cultus heatup/overheating ki common wajuhat
Step by step solution
Kya cheezein check karni chahiye
#CultusHeatupSolution #CultusOverheat #TheRoadDoctorpk #SuzukiCultus #CarOverheating

❤️ Thanks For Watching ❤️

comments.text: My cultus has grown wings since Ive followed you! The GOAT!

Good information.. Mene apni Alto bhi auto krwae hui hai aur aik LED light lagae hui hai jo k radiator fan k sath connect ki hai. Means jese hi fan on hota hai optimum temperature per pohnch kr to wo LED bhi on hojati hai. Fan off then LED bhi off. So it identifies if your thermostat valve+radiator fan is working properly. Aksar auto krwanay per aap ko pata nhe chalta k fan on hua hai ya nhe q k mostly Cultus ya Alto ki temperature needle centre mn hi rehti hai aur agr fan on hua then gasket gae. So ye LED wali trick kaam ati hai. Aap bhi krwa len

replies.text: Very practical brother. Mere case me ye hai k mene fan zra powerful lagwaya hai aur jb me gari off krne wala hota hun [PLATE REDACTED] second wait krta hun k ek baar fan ko agr chalna ho to chal kr ruk jaye phr gari off krun. Aur khari gari me fan ki awaz se he pta chal jata hai k chal rha hai to off hone k baad gari bnd krta hun.
Ap lights k sath ek extra button bhi gari me lagwa skte hain jb gari heatwave k dinon me traffic me phans jaye to button se he fan direct ho jaye aur button band krte he phr auto ho jaye.
